verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a fair question for a cloud platform with a Cloud Console, so the axis applies. However, the evidence covers only the console, Terraform, APIs, CKS, SUNK and storage features. None of it documents an in-product AI assistant that users can delegate tasks to. The llms.txt probe is a docs artifact for external LLMs, not a built-in assistant, so it earns no credit.
